ownership_reason: Only the gold reads the zone's transitions around the estimated UTC instant and decides between the two estimates of the offset and the offset at the previous transition: hops 1 and 3 each read one offset of the zone (the first estimate at the local instant, the second at the local instant less the first) and hops 2 and 4 pass the values along. The chain returns one int, from which no caller can tell which rule produced it. The gold's javadoc promises that a local time that occurs twice, in an overlap, gets the offset of its earlier instant. The convention is pinned outside the gold: the facade's own javadoc ('During a DST overlap (where the local time is ambiguous) this method will return the earlier instant'); DateTimeZone.adjustOffset, whose overlap window [transition - diff, transition + diff) is built from nextTransition and includes the last millisecond of the overlap (TestDateTimeZoneCutover testBug3192457_adjustOffset); DateTime.Property.withMaximumValue, which takes previousTransition as the last instant before a gap (TestDateTime_Properties testPropertyWithMaximumValueMillisOfDayDSTGap expects 1926-04-17T22:59:59.999Z); DateTimeZoneBuilder.PrecalculatedZone.previousTransition returns prev - 1 and ZoneInfoCompiler.test checks trans - 1 against previousTransition; test_getOffsetFromLocal_Moscow_Autumn_overlap_mins and test_DateTime_constructor_Moscow_Autumn pin the earlier offset inside the Moscow overlap.
